description: Documentation only - not loaded or validated at runtime (records are written with validate:false and checked by src/worker/validate/records.ts). An Apollo website: one per repo. Pages, posts, styles, scripts, layouts and media are separate records in the same repo, referenced here by rkey.

homePage.description: rkey of the app.sonasky.apollo.page served at the site root.

theme.description: rkey of the app.sonasky.apollo.style used as the site theme.

defaultLayout.description: rkey of an app.sonasky.apollo.layout; built-in layout when unset.

commentsDefaults.description: Whether new posts / pages start with Bluesky comments turned on (read by the editor only).

labels.description: Author-applied content warnings for the whole site.

navItem.description: Exactly one of page / url is set.

page.description: rkey of a page in this site.

url.description: https/http/mailto URL, or a relative path to a page on this site.
